_source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (checked 2026-11-20). USD per million tokens (cache writes = 5-minute rate), standard (global) rates. Haiku 5.5 rates apply to prompts up to 100K tokens.

strategies.label: Tiered classifier (Haiku / Sonnet / Opus)
strategies.description: Haiku judges each question and picks one of three models (llm_classifier, custom mode).

strategies.label: Task classifier (Haiku / Opus)
strategies.description: Haiku scores how likely the cheap model is to solve it; below the threshold it goes to Opus (llm_classifier, capability mode).

_strategiesNote: switchyard/auto is still defined in switchyard/routes.toml but left out of the UI: it routes on agent tool signals, not on the question, so plain chat always stays on Haiku.
